title: New Job, New Rules · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Lin Wei starts a new job at a small office in Shanghai. It is her first day. Her manager, Mr. Chen, shows her the desk. He explains the rules: "You have to arrive at 9 a. m. You must wear your ID card. You can take a short break at 3 p. m." Lin Wei listens carefully and writes notes so she can remember everything. On Tuesday, Lin Wei makes a mistake. She forgets to sign a form. Mr. Chen says, "You have to sign every form. You must check the date, too." Lin Wei feels bad. She says, "I'm sorry. I can fix it now." She signs the form and checks the date. Mr. Chen smiles. "Good. You can ask me questions anytime." On Friday, Lin Wei finishes her first week. She has to send a report to Mr. Chen. She must finish it before 5 p. m. She can use the computer in the meeting room.
prompt:
Part 1
What time do you start work or school?
What do you have to do every day?
Can you take a break in the afternoon?
Did you make a mistake last week?

Part 2
Describe a time when you learned a new rule at work or school. You should say: what the rule was, when you learned it, who told you, and how you felt.

Part 3
Why do workplaces have rules?
Is it easy to remember new rules?
What can happen if people forget rules?
Do you think rules change often?
